answer: Each epoch brings a census: every identity files one fresh proof of work at the ridge checkpoint, key-signed. A falcon team replays 10% of filings, and a failed replay burns the 60-credit bond. Hashes enter the juniper log, so two filings sharing one job cluster instantly and both bonds burn. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits and 1,000 real jobs against a 40,000 pool: a loss. An honest agent files once, pays 60 once, keeps its share.
